title: Playground Toy Train
hook: Choose the toy for the place, not just the letter.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D playroom storybook, rounded safe toys, simple uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Playground Toy Train

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child choosing portable toys for a setting
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: toy fact plus setting suitability when relevant
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Playground Toy Train by treating its mixed mapping as a portability/suitability sort: some toys travel easily to a playground table or blanket, while marbles, card decks, rattles, stuffed toys and Xylophone Toy may be better in controlled spaces.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child packs a play bag by asking about space, surface, wind, small parts, noise, and cleanup—not by assuming every mapped toy is playground equipment.
